settings.label: Phone number
settings.info: Longeva clinic line, confirmed by Anthony 2026-05-08. Use the international +44 form for tel: link compatibility and international callers. Leave blank to hide the phone row everywhere it renders (header, footer, contact, book page).

settings.label: Contact email
settings.info: Public contact email. Override in admin if a dedicated public-facing address (info@, clinic@) is preferred.

settings.label: Complaints email
settings.info: Used on the Complaints procedure page.

settings.label: Registered address
settings.default: Unit 1, Chichester Court, Milnrow Road, Rochdale, OL16 1UG

settings.label: Opening hours (display)
settings.default:
Monday to Friday: 9:00 to 18:00
Saturday: 9:00 to 13:00
Sunday: closed
settings.info: Free-text opening hours rendered in the booking page hero trust strip and contact card. The structured per-day fields below drive the Pharmacy JSON-LD openingHoursSpecification independently.

settings.content: Per-day open + close times in 24h HH:MM format. Drives the Pharmacy JSON-LD openingHoursSpecification block (Local Pack eligibility, 'Open now' SERP feature). Leave both Open and Close blank for a closed day.

settings.label: Mon-Fri opens
settings.info: 24h HH:MM. Leave blank to mark weekdays closed.

settings.label: Saturday opens
settings.info: Leave blank to mark Saturday closed.

settings.label: Sunday opens
settings.info: Default closed Sundays. Set HH:MM if Sunday is open.

settings.label: GPhC pharmacy registration number
settings.info: GPhC pharmacy registration number for Longeva Wellness. Keep this number and the register URL below in step.

settings.label: Price range (Schema.org)
settings.info: Used in Pharmacy JSON-LD priceRange. Symbols (£, ££, £££) or a literal range like '£120-£750'.

settings.content: Geographic coordinates and Google Maps URL strengthen local-pack eligibility. Used in Pharmacy JSON-LD geo and hasMap. Leave blank to omit.

settings.label: Clinic latitude
settings.info: Decimal degrees, e.g. 53.6097. Both lat and lon must be set.

settings.label: Clinic longitude
settings.info: Decimal degrees, e.g. -2.1561.

settings.label: Google Maps URL
settings.info: Direct link to the clinic listing on maps.google.com. Used in hasMap and as the Get directions link.

settings.content: Register and profile URLs (for schema sameAs)

Direct link to the Longeva-specific GPhC register entry. Used in: (1) the footer regulator line, (2) the About page Regulation and Governance block, (3) Pharmacy JSON-LD sameAs for SEO. Paste the verified URL. Leave blank and the link falls back to a constructed URL using the registration number above. Longeva Wellness does not hold an MHRA WDA(H) wholesale licence, so no MHRA register URL setting is offered here.

settings.label: GPhC pharmacy register entry URL
settings.info: Anthony, paste the verified Longeva-specific GPhC register entry URL here. Falls back to https://www.pharmacyregulation.org/registers/pharmacy/{GPhC number} when blank.

settings.label: Book CTA URL
settings.info: Fallback URL used only when the Sesami shop ID is not set or a page has no service ID.

settings.label: Sesami shop ID
settings.info: Numeric shop ID from Sesami admin. When set, the theme renders the Sesami Experience widget inline on pages that have a sesami_service_id metafield.

settings.label: Announcement text
settings.default: GPhC-registered pharmacy. Manchester and UK-wide delivery.

settings.label: Services grid subtitle
settings.default: Pharmacist-led consultations and treatments across seven specialities, seventy services

settings.label: Hub CTA subhead
settings.default: Same-day appointments available. A pharmacist sees every patient.

settings.label: Footer tagline
settings.default: Pharmacy-led clinical services in Rochdale, Greater Manchester.
